reason: Every load-bearing claim checks out when driven. lately.html:455 sets .center { gap: var(--gap-line) } and lately.html:116 zeroes the UA margin on h1-h4 and p, so the ladder is the only thing setting space inside this component. In ?state=empty the h2.t-sect and p.t-body are direct children of .center and measure 16.00px apart; in ?state=quiet the glyph/head/body triple measures 16.00 and 16.00. In ?state=error the same h2.t-sect + p.t-body pair is wrapped in the display:block div[role=alert] added by the r1 fix terminal-states-lose-their-heading-and-announce-nothing (lately.html:1039-1042), the wrapper is one flex child, computed gap on it is 'normal', and the two measure 0.00px apart. Driven in chromium at ?v=light and ?v=dark, at 1440, 768 and 390: 0.00 in all six. The gate claim is right too - the ladder assertion at interaction-check.mjs:608-628 walks marginTop/marginBottom only and explicitly does `if (v === 0) continue`, so a gap that was never declared is invisible to it; nothing else in the file selects [role=alert] for layout (the only [role=alert] assertion, interaction-check.mjs:1128, counts the node, not its spacing). Perceptually it is not a hairline: side by side at 1440 the empty state's headline sits clear of its sentence while the error state's headline is clamped onto it, the same composition 16px tighter, in the one state where the reader is working out what went wrong. Class is right at defect - nothing is asserted untrue and the retry still works, so it is not misleading or blocking, but at the declared bar an unintended spacing regression left behind by an accessibility fix, in a five-element state, is visibly wrong rather than a preference.
sharpenedFix: The proposed rule is correct and I verified it by injecting it at 1440 and 390: inner gap goes 0.00 -> 16.00, the wrapper keeps its 437.58px (44ch) width at 1440 and 340px at 390, h2 and p widths and left edges are unchanged, text-align:center still inherits, the button keeps its 24px (16 gap + 8 .center .btn margin-top) and its 96.34x41.25 box, and the only other change is the card growing 310.89 -> 326.89px. Prefer reusing what already exists over adding the file's first attribute selector: `.stack` at lately.html:452 is byte-for-byte the declaration proposed (display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:var(--gap-line)), so change the markup to `<div class="stack" role="alert">` at lately.html:1039 and add no CSS at all. Same measured result, one fewer rule, and the alert keeps its role and its assertive announcement either way.
